title: GraphJudge claims JSON (contracts.md §4.1)
description: Extraction OUTPUT = scorer INPUT = LLM-judge INPUT. job_id + atomic claims[]. Each claim is EITHER relational (rel+object) OR attribute (attr+value), discriminated by `kind`.

rel.$comment: OPEN vocab (contracts §4.1 v1.2, decisions #2): format-only. Canonical AI-domain reference set: developed_by, released_in, based_on, evaluated_on, sota_on, authored_by, acquired_by, cited_by. Other domains (e.g. Eval-2 personal) define their own vocab in the extraction prompt; the scorer never hardcodes it.

attr.$comment: OPEN vocab (contracts §4.1 v1.2, decisions #2): format-only. Canonical AI-domain reference set: release_year, param_count_b, context_window_k. Per-domain attrs defined in that domain's extraction prompt.
